title: job hunt - structured output for one scoring batch
description: Kept to the strict-mode-safe JSON Schema keyword set: type, properties, required, additionalProperties, items, enum. Every property is listed in `required` and every object forbids extra properties, so the model cannot return a partial object. Nullable fields use ["<type>", "null"]. Range limits (1-5, date shapes, currency codes) are enforced in Python.

jobs.description: One entry per job in the batch, in the same order as the request, echoing the request `id` exactly.

id.description: The request id, copied verbatim. Used to match the reply to the stored job.

facts.description: JD facts, exactly the contract in config/profile.toml. null means the JD does not say. Extract only what the text supports; do not infer.

min_years_experience.description: Minimum years of experience the posting requires. 0 when it asks for fresh graduates or none. null when the posting does not say.

gpa_floor.description: Stated minimum GPA on a 4.0 scale. null when not stated or stated on another scale that cannot be converted.

start_kind.description: immediate = must start now; fixed_date = a stated start date (put it in start_date); flexible = "as soon as possible" or negotiable.

start_date.description: Stated start date as YYYY-MM. null when there is no fixed date.

graduation_years.description: Graduation years the posting accepts, e.g. [2026, 2027]. Empty array when the posting does not restrict graduation year.

degree_completed_required.description: true only when the posting requires the candidate to already hold the degree at application time.

required_languages.description: Languages the posting requires, not merely prefers. Use plain names, e.g. "Thai", "English", "Chinese", "Korean", "Japanese". Empty array when none are required.

required_test_scores.description: Required test scores, e.g. "TOEIC 600", "IELTS 6.5". Empty array when none are required.

location_city.description: City the role is based in, e.g. "Bangkok", "Singapore".

location_country.description: Country the role is based in, e.g. "Thailand", "Singapore", "Hong Kong".

remote.description: true when the role is fully remote. false when it is on site or hybrid, or when the posting does not say.

job_type.description: graduate_programme covers management trainee and structured graduate schemes.

other_hard_requirements.description: Other non-negotiable conditions a fresh graduate in Bangkok may not meet, quoted or closely paraphrased: driving licence, relocation, age limit, nationality or work authorisation, portfolio, and similar. Empty array when there are none.

love.description: Ikigai circle 1, what he loves doing, scored 1-5 from config/rubric.md. null when the JD and facts.md do not give enough to judge.

reason.description: One sentence, citing a short quote from the JD or a line from facts.md. Never invent a preference.

good_at.description: Ikigai circle 2, what he is good at, scored 1-5 from config/rubric.md against the evidence in facts.md. null when there is not enough evidence.

reason.description: One sentence, citing JD requirements against a facts.md line. Never invent a skill or a number.

needs.description: Ikigai circle 3, what the world needs: how much the role's actual work matters. Scored 1-5 from config/rubric.md. null when the JD does not describe the work.

reason.description: One sentence. The basis is the posting or well-established public knowledge, as config/rubric.md defines (company momentum and growth path); it is not limited to the work itself.

paid.description: Salary evidence for Ikigai circle 4. Report the numbers only; Python computes the 1-5 score from config/profile.toml anchors.

salary_min.description: Lower bound of the monthly or annual salary in `currency`, as a plain number without separators. When a single figure is given, use it for both min and max.

salary_max.description: Upper bound in the same period and currency.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code as written in the posting: THB, SGD, USD, HKD.

period.description: The period the numbers are per. null when not stated.

stated.description: true only when the posting states the salary. false when the numbers above are your estimate for this role and market.

reason.description: One sentence: the quoted salary line, or on what basis the estimate was made when stated is false.

summary.description: One line: why this job is or is not worth applying to, in plain language, no numbers except those in facts.md.
